{{redirect|"Gold & Silver"|the video games|Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions}} {{VolumePrevNext| number=6 | series=Magical Pokémon Journey | colorscheme=Johto}} {{VolumeInfobox | image=Magical Pokémon Journey VIZ volume 6.png | number=6 | series=Magical Pokémon Journey | chapters=[[PPP31]] - [[PPP36]] | chapter=Johto }} '''Volume 6: Gold & Silver''' is the sixth of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. ==Blurb== '''IN THIS VOLUME SEVERAL NEW GOLD & SILVER POKÉMON MAKE THEIR DEBUT! PLUS…'''
Repressed {{TP|Coconut|Eevee}} falls in love and follows the questionable romantic advice of [[Hazel]] and [[Coconut]].
{{MPJ|Togepi}} arrives on the scene in the form of an egg, and {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}} do the hatching.
Hazel and [[Almond]] babysit a wild herd of {{p|Hoppip}} for a [[Cashew|Pokémon trainer]] who is even more boy-crash than Hazel and Coconut! Really!
[[Chiko|Chikorita]] arrives on the scene and challenges {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} to win [[Pistachio]]'s heart.
A {{TP|Sandy|Raichu}} ghost and its {{MPJ|Sandy|owner}} are reunited after many long, lonely years.
And more stories starring {{p|Ditto}}, {{p|Gyarados}}, {{MPJ|Machamp}}, {{MPJ|Vaporeon}}, and all your most favorite characters! ==Publications== {{publications/h|Johto}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey JP volume 6.png|edition=First|country=Japan|company=Shogakukan|date=July 26, 2000|ISBN=4091358462}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey VIZ volume 6.png|edition=First|country=United States|company=VIZ Media|date=July 31, 2002|ISBN=1569317429}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey CY volume 6.png|edition=First|country=Singapore|company=Chuang Yi|date=May 28, 2002|ISBN=9812397566}} {{publications|cover=Magical Pokémon Journey KO volume 6.png|edition=First|country={{color2|000|Pokémon in South Korea|South Korea}}|company=Haksan Culture Company|date=September 2000|ISBN=9788952903822}} {{publications|cover=|edition=First|country={{color2|000|Pokémon in Thailand|Thailand}}|company=Vibulkij Comics|date=Unknown|ISBN=9742180903}} |} ==Chapters== * ''[[PPP31|Eevee-Lu-Tion]]'' * ''[[PPP32|The Ditto Test]]'' * ''[[PPP33|Eggcellent Togepi]]'' * ''[[PPP34|The Great Togepi Disaster]]'' * ''[[PPP35|PokéMom]]'' * ''[[PPP36|Green Jealousy]]'' * ''[[PPPB13|The Terrible Omen]]'' * ''[[PPPB14|Raichu's Best Friend]]'' * ''[[PPPB15|Loves Me? Loves Me Not?]]'' ==Important events== * [[Lu]] is introduced, and confesses her love to {{TP|Coconut|Eevee}}. * {{MPJ|Togepi}} hatches from an {{pkmn|Egg}} found by {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}}. * [[Chiko]] arrives in town, where she befriends {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}}. * The Pokémon meet {{MPJ|Sandy}} and her {{TP|Sandy|Raichu}}. ==Trivia== * This volume contains two "Bonus Bonus" chapters: ** Pokémon File!: An overview of each human and Pokémon who debuted in Volume 6. ** [[Yumi Tsukirino]]'s Road to Becoming A Pokémon Master!!: Tsukirino describes her experiences playing [[Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions|Pokémon Gold and Silver]], including her worries of her upcoming battle with {{ga|Silver}}, and her struggle to capture one of every {{p|Unown}}. * In a "P.S." section, Tsukirino announces that she will no longer include joke previews for future volumes. This is due to the negative feedback she had received from young readers who felt they were being misled. {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Magical Pokémon Journey volumes|Magical Pokémon Journey volume 06]] [[es:Tomo 6 (Magical Pokémon Journey)]]
